tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i lag len mdzub tshugs ma bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// snying gi spyil bur bla ma la// gus par phyag byas thub pa'i bu// 'dod don sgrub la mi bslu ba// ho ma'i cho ga bya la zhugs// 'dir nad dang gdon bgegs dang bkra mi shis pa dang sdig pa la sogs pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ sngags la gzhol ba'am bsam gtan pa'i slob dpon gyis kyang rung ste/ snying rjer ldan pa'i sems kyis spyir bkra shis pa'i dus gza' skar sbyor tshes dge ba'i dgong thun la/ sa gzhi dkar po'i cha dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa la sogs pa'i shar du rang gzhung gis dgos na sa brtag bslang sbyang gzung gi bar byas/ thab khung gi phyed du thig chen brgyad btab/ lte ba nas mtho gang bskor bas zlum po thab khung srid du mtho gang*// nang gi de nas 'og tu'ang de tsam brko/ kha khyer nas phyir sor bzhi mu khyud du bskor ba'i phyed rtsig pa la 'byar ba/ phyed kha khyer las gyen du 'phags pa zheng sor bzhi/ yang na bris kyang rung*/ nang khyab pa'i padma dkar po 'dab brgyad/ sor brgyad pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje rtse gsum bskor ba/ phyi'i grwa bzhir rdo rje/ bud shing yaṃ shing dang mthun pa'am/ dgon pa'i lci skam srog chags med pa/ nang du thab las cung dma' ba khru gang lhag med tsam zlum por brtsig go /thab phyi nang sa dkar dang tsan dan dkar po ga pur la sogs pa'i dri bzang btab pas byugs te dkar por btang*/ me tog dkar po gcal du bkram/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas su sreg rdzas/ yaṃ shing 'o ma can gyi shing rlon pa 'da' shun dang bcas pa/ shing de dag gi rtse mo'i cha las sor bcu gnyis su byas pa snum dang dri bzang pos sbags pa/ mar gyi khu ba til la sogs pa'i sreg rdzas cha gnyis/ arghaṃ mdun/ 'thor 'thung la sogs pa mchod rdzas las dang rjes su mthun pa g.yon/ rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i yo byad mdun zur du stegs bu gtsang ma rten khebs la sogs pa'i g.yogs ma can la bkod/

dgang blugs bshams/ kun spangs yin na 'di lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo brkyang zhing g.yas pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas 'grub/ slob dpon 'khor los bsgyur ba'i chas gos dkar po shel la sogs pas brgyan/ bza' btung 'o ma la sogs sdor dkar/ stan 'jam pa nang tshangs can/ pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas gan rkyal du gnas pa padma'i skyil krung bcas/ gdong 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma byin bskrad nas/ gzhung gang yin pa'i bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms te/ de bsdus nas langs dus/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ paṃ las padma'i sdong po a las zla shel gyi gdan bting ba la/ oṃ las rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ rdzas gnyis las thams cad pa'i sngags bzla zhing ku sha'i chun pos bsangs gtor byas/ spos kyis bdug chu gsum rang gi lha'i sngags la che ge mo'i nad la sogs pa shantiṃ ku ru swā hā btags pa lan bdun bzlas pa nyer spyad lnga hūm̐ las byung bar bsam la gdan bzhir gsungs pa/ oṃ swā hā sa rdzas bkrus/ oṃ āḥswā hā sa yaṃ shing*/ oṃ shrīḥswā hā sa zhun mar/ oṃ dzreṃ swā hā sa 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā de las gzhan pa rnams sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzla/ lha rdzas kyi yo byad zhal du gsol rgyu rnams bdud rtsir/ yaṃ shing byang chub kyi shing du'o// de nas ku sha las thams cad pas bsangs gtor byas g.yas skor du/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed cing*// tshangs pa lha yi dag byed yin// bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra satwa aḥ lan gsum bzlas pas rang gi g.yon phyogs nas rtse shar du bstan nas bkram/ bram ze'am dge 'dun gyi tshang mang ngam/

dge sdig gang yang mi byed pa'i sa nas sam/ gtsub shing las byung ba'i me blangs/ me de bsangs thab kyi bud shing gi dbus su rtsa skam po'i chang bu shing gzhogs dang lhan cig me phyogs nas/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ rlung yab kyis sbar/ oṃ bhrūm̐ swā hā/ rigs kyi snying po 'am oṃ lan bdun bzlas mar gyi dgang blugs bdun blugs pas legs par sbar/ de nas las thams cad pas thab bsangs/ bhrūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa kha khyer rdo rje rtse gsum pas bskor ba lte bar chos 'byung*/ de'i dbus su padma dkar po'i steng du raṃ las skyes pa'i zhi ba'i me lha pā ba ka zla ba chu shel gyi mdog can shin tu zhi ba snyems dang ldan pa/ drang srong gi cha byad can phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin cing*/ rgyan dang na bza' dang mchod phyir thogs dkar po can 'od zer dkar po 'phro bas nad la sogs pa sel bar byed pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis rwa skyes kyi steng du bzhugs pa me'i khams kyi rang bzhin/ oṃ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// las kyi don kun sgrub pa po// snying rjes sems can don mdzad nas// 'di nyid du ni nye bar mdzod// bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus 'jig rten gyi khams shar lho'i phyogs nas drang srong chen po me'i lha pā ba ka drang srong gi 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ ṭākki ni pā ba ka hūm̐ dzaḥ 'am/ oṃ agna ye ā dī bya/ ā dī bya/ ā be sha /ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ma hā nā ya swā hā brjod pas spyan drangs/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags sumbha nis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ agna ye swā hā

sa lan bdun gyis byon skyems su mar khu 'bul/ de nas/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ mchod yon thugs kar phul/ thog mtha' 'dra/ prokkaṣa ṇāṃ/ bsang gtor sku la/ añtsa mā nāṃ/ zhal phyag bsil/ pā dyaṃ/ zhabs gsil nas/ de nas puṣpe dbu dang sku/ dhū pe shangs/ ā lo ke spyan/ gandhe thugs/ nai wi dye zhal/ shapta snyan la phul te/ oṃ/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa'i don kun bsgrub mdzad pa// tshangs pa'i dbang po mchog gi sras// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi mdzes pa'i gzugs// rdo rje rtse gsum bgrang 'phreng dang*// dbyig pa ril ba spyi blugs bsnams// sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa// dkar zhing zhi ba'i snyems dang ldan// thor tshugs me tog cod pan can// rgyan dang na bza' mchod phyir thogs// shin tu dkar zhing mdzes pas brgyan// phyogs bcur 'od zer bsil ba yis// nad dang gdon la sogs pa 'joms// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa// pā ba ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// lag pa g.yon 'jig rten pa'i khu tshur du byas pa'i g.yas pa 'bar ba ltar byas pa bstan te/ gur las gsungs pa/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta/ dzwa la dzwa la/ sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ dṛ ṣya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas me lha dam tshig la gnas te zhi ba'i las bcol ba zhal gyis bzhes te sgrub pa la 'dun par bsam mo// de nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur mthe bong gi phyi mnan pa mdzub mo bsgrengs pas dgang gzar bzung ba'i mdzub mo'i steng du g.yas pa de lta bus blugs gzar bzung ba bzhag pa byang chub mchog gi khu tshur zhes bya bas bzung*/ gru mo pus mo'i phyir mi 'da' bas/ dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi kha la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od zer dang bcas pa me lha zhal cung zad gdangs par raṃ/ dgang gzar mar khus bkang ste/ rang gi sdig pa zhi ba'i don yin na dam sngags de'

ི duṣṭaṃ gyi mthar bi ghnāṃ btags pa me lha'i sngags su rdo rje mkha' 'gror de'i mtha' la/ ma ma sarba pā paṃ shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gzhan gyi ched yin na che ge mo sarba/ gzhan 'dra/ de bzhin nad zhi ba'i don yin na/ sarba ro gaṃ rims zhi ba'i don yin na sarba dzwa raṃ/ bgegs zhi ba la sarba bi ghnāṃ/ gnod pa zhi ba la sarba a pa ka taṃ/ las kyi sgrib pa zhi ba la sarba karma ā ba ra ṇāṃ zhes sbyar te spyi bkos kyi tshul du mar khu g.yas skor gyis lan bdun phul/ de nas thog mar yaṃ shing dbus nas lag pa gnyis kyi ming med dang mthe'u chung gis bzung ste/ ku sha la'ang 'dra de gnyis 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la 'bul/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhag til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ye swā hā/ yungs dkar/ oṃ sarba artha siddha ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ badzra bi dza ye swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badzra ghasma rī swā hā/ 'bru rnams phyag tu/ zho zan/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zhal/ 'o ma sbags pa'i durba mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ 'o til mar gyis byugs pa'i ku sha /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swā hā/ bil ba dang star kha 'bul na/ oṃ ma hā she pa ye swā hā/ me tog la sogs pa gzhan thams cad tshim par byed pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ de sngon du btang ba'i sngar gyi snying po'i sngags des 'bul la/ thams cad la lha rdzas las sngags mthar swā hā sbyar/ de yang re re 'am bdun nas stong la sogs pa'i bar du phul nas/ slar chu bzhi nyer mchod byas bla med la chang gi mchod pa yang bya'o// de nas/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho'i me lha 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod pas tshim ste/

rdo rje'i me lha de de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su dpa' bo gcig pa'am gang dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor rten brten par bcas par bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug pa la/ rdul tshon dang 'brel na/ lha so so'i sngags bzlas zhing me tog gis tshon te rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las dar lam rol mo dang bcas spyan drangs la me tog dbus su dor bas lha rnams thab tu bskyed pa la thim par bsam/ rab tu gnas pa'i tshe rten gang yin pa de de ltar spyan drangs shing sngags sngar gyis phul mchod bstod byas dgang blugs/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra agni badzra sa twa sarba pa paṃ da ha swā hā zhes pas mar khu lan bdun phul bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis me lha'i bya ba byed par zhal gyis bzhes/ zhi ba'i las bsgrub bzhed nas zhi ba'i nyams 'dzin par gyur/ me pra brtag ngan na las thams cad pas me de la bgegs skrod lha'i sngags kyis bsangs gtor byas/ mar gyi sreg blugs/ oṃ agna ye a mu ka zhes par me lha'i ming pā ba ka gzhug ba sa a ti laṃ ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum phul/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sreg blugs 'bul ba'i thog mar/ ting 'dzin / oṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar zhing bsil ba'i khar seṅge padma zla ba'i gdan la/ bsgrub bya dmigs nas/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis bskul bas me dbus kyi lha rnams kyi sku las sprul pa dpag tu med pa bkye bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i chus phyi nang bkrus pas nad la sogs pa zhi// mngon par 'dod pa thams cad bsgrubs sprul pa rang la 'dus par bsams nas/ rang gi lha'i sngags kyis sreg blugs bdun spyi bsgos su phul/ lhag ma yi ge gsum sngon du 'gro bas lha rdzas las sngags kyi mthar swā hās go rim bzhin du sreg go

/de nas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gam/ 'di la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dam tshig nyams chags mtho ris dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gdon bzlog na/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang des byung ba'i gdon chen po bco brgyad dang*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu ltas ngan pa dang ye 'brog dang*/ log 'dren dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ byad stems dang*/ pha rol gyi rig sngags las gyur pa'i gnod pa/ mi shis pa bzlog na/ me dang chu dang sa g.yo ba dang rlung gi gnod pa dang lo nyes pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa dang byur dang*/ skal ba ngan pa dang dbul zhing phongs pa dang*/ dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa brgyad dang*/ mu ge dang phyugs nad dang*/ mi nad dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang de dag gi rgyu bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa gsol/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ gtso bo bdag cag nus med pas// ma 'byor ba dang ma rig dang*// dman pa'am ni lhag pa ste// gang bgyis de khyod bzod par mdzod// de nas/ badzra sa twa zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad kyi tshigs su bcad pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na me tog dang bcas pas de nas gdan drangs slar dkyil 'khor chen por sngar ji lta ba bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ de nas thab tu me lha 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur pa la/ chum̐ gsumam̐ rnamam̐ lnga rolam̐ mosam̐ mchod// sreg rdzas lhag ma tsho phul// 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam 'dud dam/ rgyas par/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog

/'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa'i// rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi bcud ldan gandhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la gsol// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gal te gzhan gyi don du yin na des yon phul te/ de'i mthe bong g.yas pa rang gi g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gis bzung ste/ thab khung la lan gsum bskor ba byas la/ blugs gzar de'i mgo la g.yas skor du bskor bas blugs gzar gyis mar lan bdun 'bul du gzhug/ hūm̐ bzlas pa'i bsrung skud dkar pos dpung pa bcing*/ me lha'i zhabs drung nas blangs pa'i thal ba cung zad cig gis dpral bar thig le byas la bsang gtor gyis bsrung*/ de nas me lha la mchom̐d yom̐n phulam̐ la dngos grub blang*/ nyes pa bzod par gsol te/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon cing*// bdag la dngos grub kun 'grub mdzod// oṃ gatstsha gatstsha

zhes gshegs/ thal ba la sogs pa legs par phyags la phyogs gtsang zhing dben par bzhag go /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg go// / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ dga' ba dang ldan pas gza' tshes skar ma dus sbyor bzang po'i snga dro/ sa gzhi ser po'i cha grong khyer sogs kyi byang du/ sa chog sngon du 'gro bas thab khung rgyar khru do/ dpangs su de'i phyed zur brgyad pa'am bzhi pa/ nang du khru gang thur du brkos pa/ kha nas sor brgyad phyir bskor ba'i phyed kha'i 'og phyed steng du thon pa kha khyer zheng dpangs dang mnyam pa/ mtshan ma de'i nang khyab pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser po/ dbus su rdo rje rin po che zur brgyad pa bris/ kha khyer la rin po ches bskor ba phyi'i grwa 'dra/ sa ser gi'u waṃ gur kum la sogs pa'i dri'i khu bas thab phyi nang ser por byugs/ nang du bud shing dgon pa'i lci skam mi rung gzhan zhi ba bzhin brtsigs/ me tog ser po gcal du bkram/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas su sreg rdzas yaṃ shing zhi ba lta bu la/ shing de'i dbus kyi cha las byung ba tshad khru gang dri ser po'i chu zho 'o ma mar la bsngags pa/ mngar gsum gyis bsgos pa/ mar khu/ zho zan/ rin po che lnga bgo ba bzang po la sogs pa/ dgang blugs/ mchod pa las mthun g.yon/ rnal 'byor gyis yo byad mdun zur du bkod/ bza' btung zho la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa/ gos rgyan ser po/ stan khri'u shing la 'phongs bzhag rkang mgo mthil du phab pa gshibs pus mo cung zad skyed pa bzang po'i 'dug stangs/ yang na khri 'jam por rkang pa g.yas pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas nas g.yon pa 'gying ba dang bcas pas rab tu brkyang ba rol pa'i 'dug stangs gang bdes kha byang du bltas 'dug nas bzhin 'dzum pas bgegs zhi ba'i phyir gtoram̐ ma btangam̐ bskradam̐/ gzhung gang yin pa'i bdagam̐ bskyedam̐ bsgomam̐s/ bsdusam̐/ de las langam̐s pa'i dus su

laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor paṃ las padma/ ma las nyi ma'i gdan la trāṃ las rang nyid rin chen 'byung gnas sku mdog ser po rin po che cha dgu pa dang rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ rdzas gnyis las thams cad pas bsangs/ spos kyis bdug chu gsum lha'i sngags la bdag gam/ gzhan gyi don gang yin pa la che ge mo'i 'chad 'gyur gyi 'dod pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ lan bdun bzlas/ nyer spyad lnga/ rgyal srid bdun la sogs pa hūm̐ las byung ba/ oṃ swā hā sa bkru/ oṃ āḥswā hā yaṃ shing*/ oṃ shrīḥswā hā zhun mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hā 'bru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā de las gzhan pa'i rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis thams cad/ lha rdzas zhal du gsol rgyu rnams bdud rtsir/ yaṃ shing byang chub kyi shing du byin gyis brlab/ de nas ku sha bsang gtor byas/ sked pa'i cha nas mtheb srin sbyar bas bzung ste/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge 'i tshigs bcad rdzogs pa'i mthar / phun tshogs rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa aḥ zhes lan gsum gyis/ rang gi mdun nas rtse byang du bstan pas thab kyi kha khyer la g.yas skor nang du'ang bkram/ rgyal po'am dge 'dun gyi tshang ngam/ phyug po'i khyim nas sam/ me shel las byung ba'i me blangs/ de bsangs nas thab kyi dbus su me phyogs nas/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bcug rlung g.yab kyis sbar/ oṃ traṃ swā hā 'am/ traṃ rang lan bdun brjod pa mar gyi dgang blugs kyis legs par spar/ de nas thab bsangs/ bhrūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po zur brgyad pa 'am/ gru bzhi pa/ rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha khyer rin po ches bskor ba nang du 'khor lo// lte bar raṃ las skyes pa'i me lha dbang chen gser sbyangs pa'i mdog can sku sha rgyas pa 'dzum pa gzi brjid chen po/

drang srong gi cha byad can phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rtse gsum dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin cing rgyan dang na bza' mchod phyir thogs ser po can/ 'od zer gur kum gyi khu ba lta bus phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par byed pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis ra skyes kyi steng du bzhugs pa me'i khams kyi rang bzhin/ oṃ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// nas/ me'i lha dbang chen drang srong gi 'khor/ oṃ ṭakki ni ma hend+ra hūm̐ dza 'am/ oṃ agna ye nas bstod pa'i bar zhi bar bshad pa bzhin la/ ser zhing rgyas pa'i byin dang ldan// dang*/ shin tu gser mdog mdzes pas brgyan// phyogs bcur 'od zer rgyas pa yis// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bskyed// 'gro ba'i re ba gang mdzad pa// ma hend+ra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam mo// phyam̐g rgyam̐ dang*/ oṃ a na lā 'i sngags kyis me lha dam tshig la gnas te rgyas pa'i las bcol ba zhal gyis bzhes/ de bsgrub pa la 'dun par gyur/ de nas rdo rje bsdams pa'i mdzub mo bkug pa'i sor mo mnyam pa'i nor bu mthe bong rdo rjes bkab pa rdo rje nor bu/ de gnyis su byas pa rin chen khu tshur gyis dgang blugs pus mo'i nang mi 'da' bar bzung*/ spel tshig tshe rgyas pa'i don du yin na ma ma ā yuḥpuṣṭi ku ru oṃ/ bsod nams rgyas pa la puṇya/ dbang thang rgyas pa la sau bha gyaṃ/ nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la dha n+yaṃ/ zhes btags pa dang*/ 'jig rten 'das pa la me pra brtag bzlog dus ma hend+ra gzhug rgyas pa'i las bsgrub par bzhed nas rgyas pa'i nyams 'dzin par gyur/ bsgrub bya laṃ las byung ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi khar glang po che la zhon pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed bskul bas me dbus kyi lha rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros de la thim/

mngon par 'dod pa thams cad rgyas par gyur par bsam pa dang*/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gam 'di'i tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang gzi brjid dang stobs dang mnga' thang dang nor dang longs spyod dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// dngos grub sgrub na gang sgrub pa de 'grub par gsol ba 'debs pa yin no// de tsam 'don pa bsgyur/ gzhan thams cad zhi bar bshad pa dang ji lta ba bzhin du bya'o// rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg go /'ga' zhig dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// chags pa'i sems kyis/ gza' tshes skar ma dus sbyor dbang la shis pa yod pa'i mtshan mo'i dus/ sa gzhi dmar po'i cha/ grong khyer la sogs pa'i nub kyi phyogs su sa chog thab khung skye gnas kyi dbyibs lta bu zur gsum pa'am/ zla gam/ rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs de'i phyed kha khyer sor bzhi pas bskor ba/ mtshan ma nang du padma kha khyer yang de bzhin/ bud shing ro skyur ba me tog dang bcas pas brtsig tsan dan dmar po la sogs pa'i dri chu dmar po dang*/ tshon dmar pos phyi nang dmar por btang me tog dmar po gcal du bkram/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas su sreg rdzas/ yaṃ shing bud shing lta bu la/ shing gang gi yal ga'i cha la byas pa sor lnga pa'i tshad/ me tog 'bras bur bcas pa/ gzhan zhi rgyas bzhin la/ tsan dan dmar po/ me tog dmar po'i rigs/ mchod rdzas las mthun g.yon/ chos gos rgyan dmar po/ 'dug stangs brla g.yon pa'i steng du rkang pa g.yas pa bzhag la/ g.yon brla g.yas pa'i 'og tu bzhag pa sems skyil gyis kha nub tu bltas/ bzhin 'dzum pa/ bgegs zhi ba'i phyir gtom̐r ma btang*/ gzhung gang yin pa'i bam̐dag bskyedam̐ bsgomam̐s/ de bsdusam̐ nas de las langam̐s pa'i dus raṃ las/ me'i dkyil 'khor/ paṃ las padma ma las nyi ma'i gdan la/ hrīḥ las rang nyid rdo rje chags pa dmar po padma dang padma'i dril bu 'dzin pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/

rdzas gnyis lam̐s thams cam̐d pas bsangs/ sposam̐ kyis bdug chu gam̐sum lha'i sngags kyi mthar/ che ga ེ mo wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ nyer spyad lnga hūm̐ las byung ba/ oṃ swā hā rdzas rnams bkrus/ oṃ āḥswā hā yaṃ shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hā zhun mar/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hā 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā de las gzhan pa rnams sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha rdzas zhal du gsol rgyu bdud rtsi/ yaṃ shing a sho ka'o// de nas ku sha bsangam̐s mtheb srin gyis dbus kyi cha nas bzung*/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ shlau ka rdzogs pa'i mthar/ che ge mo dbang du bsdu bar mdzod// oṃ badzra sa twa aḥ lan gsum bzlas/ rang gi g.yon phyogs nas/ rtse mo nub tu phyogs pa thab la g.yas skor du bkram/ tshong 'dus sam smad 'tshong ma'i khyim nas me blangs te bsangam̐s/ thab kyi bud shing gi dbus su/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ rlung g.yab kyis sbar/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā 'am/ hrīḥ lan gsum bzlas/ de nas thab bsangam̐s/ hūm̐ las dbang gi thab khung dmar po zur gsum mam/ zla gam/ rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ kha khyer padmas bskor ba/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma la raṃ las skyes pa'i me lha dmar po li khri khu ba lta bu'i mdog can shin tu chags pa chen pos sgeg pa/ drang srong gi cha byad can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin zhing*/ rgyan dang na bza' dang mchod phyir thogs dmar po can 'od zer dmar po khams gsum po thams cad dbang du sdud pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis ra skyes kyi steng du bzhugs pa me'i khams kyi rang bzhin/ oṃ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// nas/ me'i lha dmar po drang srong gi 'khor// oṃ ṭaṭṭi ni ka ma hūm̐ dza/ bstod pa'i bar 'dra/ bstod pa'i/ dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan// dang*/ shin tu dmar shing mdzes pas brgyan// phyogs bcur 'od kyi lcags kyu yis// khams gsum thams cad dgug byed cing*// dbang du sdud par mdzad pa yi// dmar po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//

dam tshig brjod pas/ me lha dam tshig la gnas te dbang gi las bcol ba zhal gyis bzhes te sgrub pa la 'dun par gyur/ de nas dgang blugs/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ mthe bong mnyam par brkyang la/ dbus ma gnyis phyi rol du gshibs pa dang bcas bzhag pa/ de gnyis su byas pa padma'i khu tshur te/ des bzung gru mo pus mo'i/ nang mi 'da' bas/ sngags kyi mthar che ge ma ོ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes sbyar/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skabs dbang gi las bsgrub par bzhed nas chags pa'i nyams 'dzin par gyur/ bsgrub bya yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bud med du gnas pa/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed bskul bas/ me dbus kyi lha rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog gi rnam par spros bsgrub bya skyes pa'i snying khar/ bud med kyi bha gar lcags kyu btab zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gi rnam pas bsdams nas dril bus mnyes/ rlung gis bdag gi mdun du gzugs brnyan la gzhug de la rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer dmar po zhugs/ lus gang de'i lus ngag yid gsum bsdus nas bdag gi snying khar thim/ dbang du 'dus par bsam/ me pra brtag bzlog dus ka ma la mig 'bras gnyis g.yon du phyogs pas bsreg 'dod gsol che ge ma ོ bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ gzhan zhi ba bzhin la sbyin bdag bskor ba mi byed/ dbang gi sbyin sreg go /gdug pa can la mngon spyod kyi las bya ba'i phyir/ sdang ba'i sems kyis drag po la shis pa'i gza' skar tshes dus sbyor gyi nyin phyed dam mtshan phyed la/ sa gzhi rtsub cing tsha sgo can/ kha dog nag cing gas pa dur sa'am 'jig rten gyi ma mo'i gnas sa/ grong khyer la sogs pa'i lho/ thab khung gru gsum pa rgyar sor mo nyi shu/ phyed kyi srid dang ldan pa/ nang du sor bcu thur du brkos pa/ kha nas sor gsum phyir bor ba'i kha khyer sor gsum gyi dpangs zheng can/

sa nag po dang bong bu dang rnga mong gi sbangs dang*/ ro thal dang*/ phub ma dang sol phye bsres pas phyi nang byugs dri mi zhim pa'i me tog dang*/ 'bru nag dang phub ma gtor/ nang du khro bo'i rdo rje rtse gsum sor brgyad pa'i tshad/ phyi zur la sna tshogs rdo rje mdung rtse gsum rdo rje tho ba bri/ kha khyer ral gris bskor/ bud shing dri mi zhim pa ro kha ba tsher ma rno ba'i shing dur khrod du skyes pa skam po dang*/ bong bu dang rnga mong gi sbangs skam po dang*/ nim pa dang seng ldeng gi shing 'ug pa'i sgro dang bcas pas thab las cung dma' bar brtsig sgrub po'i g.yon du yaṃ shing*/ bud shing du bshad pa'i shing rnyings pa rtse nyams pa shun pa med cing gas pa/ thung ring sbom/ 'khyog po/ grum chag 'bus zos/ srog chags ldan pa skams pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'i cha las tshad sor bcu gnyis pa rtse gnyis rtsub pa'am rno ba dug khrag zhag chen pos sbags pa/ tsha ba'am yungs kar gyi mar khu/ khrag dang lan tshwa dang nim pa'i lo ma dur khrod kyi rus thal/ bong bu rnga mong gi sbangs dang skra dang zhag bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgro/ bshang gci sha khrag lhag par sgrub pa byas pa'i liṅga gtubs te rkang rjes kyi sa dang lhan cig btags pa ming rus snying khar bkod pa'i ling chung drug cu rtsa brgyad byas/ g.yas su lcags kyi snod du khrag dang ko ṭa pa'i khu ba dang*/ mi'am ba lang ngam bong bu'i gcin gyi mchod yon sogs las mthun gyi nyer mchod rol mo dang bcas pa bsham/ dgang blugs dang rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i yo byad kyis bstar la/ bdud ging las la 'jug pa'i chas su zhugs pa'am/ gcer bu skra lhug par 'phyang ba/ kha zas sha za dpa' bo'i btung ba 'thung*/ stan sra zhing rtsub pa'am ro gdan bris par stang stabs rkang pa g.yon pa skyil krung phyed par byas/ de dang nye bar pus mo g.yas pa steng du drang por byas pa khro bo'i skyil krung bcings nas/

kha lhor bltas khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i gdong*/ bgegs la gtoram̐ ma btangam̐ bskradam̐/ bdagam̐ bskyed gzhung bzhin bsgoms nas bsdusam̐/ de las langam̐s dus yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor la paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma dang mi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje khro bo mi bskyod pa sku mdog mthing kha rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan nas khro bo'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ las thams cad pa'i chus rdzas rnams bsangs/ sha chen dang gu gul gyis bdugs/ rang gi lha'i sngags la che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ btags pa lan bdun nyer spyad lnga hūm̐ las/ oṃ swā hās rdzas bkrus/ oṃ aḥswā hā yaṃ shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā mar khu/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hā sa 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de las gzhan pa rnams sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha rdzas zhal du gsol rgyu bdud rtsi/ yaṃ shing de dag nyid/ de nas ku sha bsangam̐s gtor byas/

ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ nas/ che ge 'di la mngon spyod mdzod// oṃ badzra sa twa aḥ lan gsum gyis rang gi g.yas phyogs nas thab kyi kha khyer la rtse mo lhor bstan nas g.yon skor du bkram/ gshan ra nas me blangs bsangam̐s / oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ zhes pas sbar/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā 'am/ hūm̐ lan bdun gyis mar khu blugs/ legs par sbar/ de nas las thams cad pas thab bsangam̐s/ bhrūm̐ las drag po'i thab khung zur gsum nag po rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa kha khyer ral gris mtshan pa/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las skyes pa'i drag po'i me lha rlung mun pa'i mdog can shin tu khro zhing gtum pa/ sbom zhing gel ba drang srong gi cha byad can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin cing rgyan dang*/ na bza' dang mchod phyir thogs nag po can 'od zer mthing nag sna la mtshon cha sna tshogs skar mda' lta bur 'phro bas bstan pa nyams par byed pa'i dgra lha srung dang bcas pa brlag par byed pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis ra skyes kyi steng na bzhugs pa me'i khams kyi rang bzhin/ oṃ/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// nas/ oṃ ṭakki ni kro dha te dza hūm̐ dza 'am/ oṃ agna ye nas/ bstod pa'i bar/ nag cing khro la gtum pa'i sku// dang*/ shin tu nag pas mdzes par brgyan// phyogs bcur 'od kyi skar mda' yis// bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs 'joms// nag po'i phyogs rnams rlag byed pa// rlung zhes bya la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam tshig brjod/ me lha dam tshig la gnas te dgra bo che ge mo la mngon spyod kyi las bcol ba sgrub par bsam/ de nas rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo sdigs mdzub tu byas pa/ khro bo'i khu tshur des dgang blugs gru mo pus mo las phyir phyogs pas bzung*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la/

hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od zer dang me lha zhal cher gdangs par raṃ me lha'i sngags la dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ ngam phaṭ btags pas/ sreg blugs g.yon du bskor bas 'bul/ yi gem̐ gsumam̐ sngonam̐ du btang*/ me'i sngags la oṃ badzrā ya/ spel tshig yaṃ shing*/ oṃ agna ye/ mar nag 'dir liṅga skad cig gis bsgrub byar dmigs nas yi ge gsum me lha'i sngags kyi mthar spel tshig lhag ma rnams nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis me lha'i bya ba byed par zhal gyis bzhes/ dgra bo che ge mo la mngon spyod kyi las bsgrub par bzhed nas drag po'i nyams 'dzin par gyur/ me pra brtag bzlog dus/ me lha'i ming kro dha te dza gzhug ting nge 'dzin/ ling ga raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ gzas pa lus gcer bu kha lhor bltas pa skyob byed dang bral bas ngu zhing brgyal bar bsam la/ khams gsum gnon pa'i bsam pas kha me phyogs bltas/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis bskul bas me dbus kyi lha rnams kyi sku las sprul pa dpag tu med pa bkye/ de rnams kyis dgra bo'i bsrung ba'i gur khang bshig skyob byed kyi ye shes lha mchod/ 'di ma rungs pas skyob mi rigs par gsol bas de dag gis spangs/ 'jig rten pa'i lha rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu bskrad/ de'i mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ snying khar lcags kyu btab/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ rgyab nas khro bos rdeg cing las kyi rlung dmar gyis ded/ 'jigs pa'i mun pas bsus nas dmigs rten de la bstim/ sngags las thams cad pa'i sham bur dza btags la bzlas/ de nas/ slar spros pa'i 'od me'i khab lta bu de'i bshang lam nas zhugs tshe rten bdag la phul/ rang gi tshe'i gsos/ srog rten yi ge hūm̐ me des sbyangs nas 'og min du spar/ lnga phung pho nya rnams kyis gtubs lha rnams kyi zhal gdangs pa der phul bar bsam la/ sngags re ling ga re spel gyin sreg

gzhan zhi ba bzhin/ 'dod gsol/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams par byed cing dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smod pa sdig can gyi dgra bo che ge mo 'di lo dang zla bar ma 'gyangs zhag dang za ma 'di nyid du rtags phyungs mtshan ma ston lnga phung bshig yid rten chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar ba tsam mo// de ltar las bzhi nyid du las gzhan 'du bas gal te so sor bya bar 'dod na/ de dang de'i rdzas dmigs pa/ 'dod gsol bsgyur ba tsam/ las thams cad pa zhi bar gtso bar byed na de bzhin la/ yaṃ shing la sogs pa la so so'i phan yon dang bstun pa'i spel tshig sbyar ba tsam ste bsnyen pa'i kha skong*/ de bzhin dngos grub bsgrub pa rnams rgyas pa'i las dang bstun no// kun spangs la/ ji skad bshad pa thams cad yid kyis bsam pas 'grub par gsungs so// rgyud gsungs bdag nyid ches bkral ba// ma nor 'di zhes mdzub btsugs pa// rmongs zhen mig nyams ngor min gyi// 'dod don bslu med sgrub 'dod la'o// zhes las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bca' bde ba zhig dgos zhes gnam mtsho do pa sogs don gnyer mang pos bskul nas rgyun ring*/ slar yang nan tan du byed pa dag gi ngor rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung mdzub btsugs su bstan pa sngags 'chang padma dkar pos shar kong po za yul bka' brgyud chos ldings kyi dgon par sbyar ba bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du dar bar gyur cig gu// /maṅgalaṃ/// /
